replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
We have no proof that it was your brother moving the mouse. The evidence also disproves that claim, as he does not move even as people moved around him. Moreover, the "kill aura" reasoning was incorrect and was not what it should have been.

Thus, I'm forced to deny this appeal. I'll leave it open for 24 hours so that any questions or objections can be raised. If you wish for this to be escalated, please notify us via this thread.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Ok so,

As I see it, you were using triggerbot in the evidence provided. Even if you were in spectator mode, why did you have triggerbot in the first place? It doesn't matter if you were a spectator when it happened. Also, about 10 minutes before you went afk, you typed /join. Its under suspicion that you could have been using it while playing too. I highly doubt that your brother was clicking the mouse when you weren't there. This is because the clicks were timed almost perfectly whenever a player got in a specific radius.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in about 6-8 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Neyke
